WHY HOLYCORES

Bring advanced AI
wherever it matters.

Useful compute lives beyond benchmarks. It must enter enterprises, cities, devices, and real workflows—creating a better balance across performance, economics, privacy, and sustainability.
01

Broader access to AI

Extend intelligence from centralized infrastructure to private environments and field devices, with the right form factor for every scale.

02

Closer to data and decisions

Reduce unnecessary data movement and run latency-sensitive models where results are needed.

03

Clearer data boundaries

Support local and private deployment for sensitive information, regulated industries, and critical operations.

04

Controllable system economics

Evaluate utilization, capacity, energy, and operations around real workloads—not isolated peak numbers.

05

More responsible compute

Use dataflow, hardware-software co-design, and layered deployment to reduce waste across the system.

Real hardware makes product boundaries tangible. HOLYCORES carries silicon and software into installable, coolable, and interconnected form factors.
CLOUD / RACK-SCALE SYSTEM

GALAXY G72

An integrated rack bringing compute, fabric, liquid cooling, telemetry and management into one production system.

  • Up to 72-accelerator planning scale
  • Rack-wide HC-Fabric
  • Integrated liquid-cooling plan
Explore GALAXY systems →
DATACENTER / SINGLE ACCELERATOR

NOVA N100

A single-chip PCIe accelerator for developer workstations, private AI, and general inference servers.

  • PCIe 5.0 ×16 host interface
  • 24 GB target memory
  • Dual-slot active cooling plan
Explore the NOVA family →
DATACENTER / SCALE-OUT

NOVA N200

A dual-chip platform with dedicated card fabric for throughput, multi-card scaling, and dense servers.

  • Dual-chip compute board
  • 48 GB target memory
  • Active and passive variants
Compare NOVA models →
EDGE / EMBEDDED MODULE

SPARK S20

A compact, low-power local inference module for robotics, vision, and intelligent devices.

  • Compact M.2 form factor
  • Local model and sensor path
  • 15 W-class power target
Explore the SPARK family →
